judgment.notes: Componentwise first time derivative on R^n×(0,∞), valued in R^m. H001/H002 provide dimensions and derivative existence; no additional property is assumed.
Componentwise second time derivative has the stated domain/codomain, depends on D001, and is guarded by H001/H002. No equation or regularity of the normal scalar is introduced.

Spatial coordinate indices range from 1 to n; iterated and mixed notation and Frobenius square are explicit. D001 and H001/H002 supply the required objects and derivatives. The notation does not assume mixed-derivative equality.
The componentwise Laplacian is exactly the finite sum of spatial second derivatives, with dependence on D003 and H001/H002; sign and domain agree with the original normality equation.

Lebesgue spatial measure and its coordinate product convention, restricted on boxes, and Euclidean dot products/norms specify the intended normalization. This fixes notation for the standard measure, not an assumption of integrability or a Fubini conclusion. H001 supplies finite dimensions.
Real density is exactly |u_t|² plus the finite sum of spatial derivative squares; D001/D003 and H001/H002 supply all components. No finiteness of its spatial integral is granted.

e_t means the time derivative of D006. H001/H002 make the density differentiable by the ordinary rules for derivatives of finite sums of smooth component products. The definition asserts neither a differentiation-under-integral formula nor its use.

Finite Lebesgue energy is explicitly guarded by N002, whose complete statement exports integrability for every positive time. D005/D006 give measure and density. N002 does not depend on D008; R003 and R005 each list N002 and H001/H002 directly. Thus the guard is neither a new root assumption nor circular, and differentiability/conservation remain conclusions.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
